types.description: Provisional generic control relay with an unrated coil and one changeover contact (11 common, 12 NC, 14 NO).

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: A1/A2 are required for electrical coil actuation. One changeover is represented by NC 11/12 and NO 11/14 sharing the same physical common 11; states refer to a de-energized coil. Relations associate the contacts without joining nets or simulating transfer timing. Optional: each throw by application; require common and each used throw in project review. Unmodeled: additional contacts, suppressors, electronics and bonding. Author must select hardware and add coil voltage, AC/DC class and contact ratings. No manufacturer pinout is asserted.
